title: If as Expression
concept: In XIOM, if can be used as an expression — it produces a value you can assign to a variable.
why: When both branches produce values of the same type, using if as an expression is cleaner than declaring a variable and assigning in each branch.
syntax_ref:
let var = if condition { value_if_true } else { value_if_false };
// Both branches must produce the same type
tips: Both branches of an if-expression must return the same type
No semicolon after the value in each branch — it's returned automatically
If-expression is great for assignments where the choice determines the value
You can use elif in expressions too: `if a {1} elif b {2} else {3}`
common_mistakes: Putting a semicolon after the branch value: `{ "Pass"; }` turns it into Unit
Returning different types from each branch
Forgetting the `else` — an if-expression must cover all cases (needs else)
